sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Cult is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You know, I don't work only with you. I have one very useful and resourceful informant, but he has not checked in for quite some time. The last information I received from him mentioned a strange glow and mysterious voices near the old village. He said he would investigate what was happening, and then disappeared. Find him, or at least find out what may have happened to him."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the missing informant on Shoreline
- Survive and extract from the location

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,00 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
- 1,100 Dollars
  - 1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Kurwa! This is far too strange... I will continue looking into it myself. Thanks!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: The informant is located in a ruined house in the swamps of Shoreline. You can find it by locating the church and following a blood trail.
